parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Bori-police-station (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 150 | 1.23 | 1.23
2 | 97.1 | 6.21 | 7.44
3 | 284 | 37.5 | 45
4 | 700 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Bori-police-station (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HA-type ($\rho_1 > \rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4$)
Aquifer depth: 7.44 – 45.0 m
Recommendation: Drill to a total depth of 45.0 m to fully penetrate the main saturated horizon (Layer 3) without advancing into the resistive basal unit. Install borehole screens within the 15.0 – 42.0 m interval with an appropriate gravel pack for optimal groundwater yield.
